---
applyTo: "spec/**"
---
# Specification

- Each file stays under ~8 KB; split by topic at top-level `#` headings and update `spec/index.md`.
- MUST/SHOULD/MAY are normative; use the terminology table in `spec/01-overview.md`.
- When the implementation disagrees with the spec, fix the spec and record a decision in `docs/decisions/` (update its README table).
- Cross-check section names referenced from other spec files when renaming headings.
